text:
Alex: quick question about mid-stream tool calls — are we comfortable with allowing a tool to be "reopened" after an initial "tool_call_finished" event if the model emits more data?
Maria: iirc we decided not to allow reopening for v1, because it complicates client state. why do we need it?
Alex: two real cases: 1) tools that stream partial results and then the model asks the tool for a clarification (rare), 2) model wants to append additional metadata after the tool produced output (more common for long responses).
Sam: reopening introduces racey semantics. clients need a deterministic way to know when a tool's output is final. we currently have `tool_call.finished = true` as the gate.
Kiara: can we instead add a separate finalization signal that is idempotent and append-only? e.g. `tool_call_final` event that can occur later to mark finality, while earlier `tool_call_chunk` events stream content.
Ethan: proposed schema snippet (quick):
```json
{"event":"tool_call_chunk","tool_id":"search","data":"..."}
{"event":"tool_call_final","tool_id":"search","status":"ok","checksum":"sha256:..."}
```
Alex: that looks reasonable. question: if we allow a `tool_call_final` to appear after a `tool_call_finished` should we treat `tool_call_finished` as deprecated?
Sam: +1 to `tool_call_final` as canonical finality signal. We can treat `tool_call_finished` (boolean on message) as legacy for backcompat but ignore if `tool_call_final` is present.
Maria: migration implications: clients that depend on `finished=true` will still work, but new clients should prefer `tool_call_final`. Need to document order guarantees: `tool_call_chunk*` -> optional `tool_call_finished` -> optional `tool_call_final`. If both final signals present, `tool_call_final` wins.
Kiara: what about streaming clients that reassemble tool output mid-stream? they need stable offsets. we should add `offset` on chunks and a `sequence_id` per tool_call to make reassembly deterministic.
Alex: yep add `sequence_id` and `offset`. also add `final_size` optionally in `tool_call_final` so clients can verify completeness.
ops-bot: deploy-check: schema change will require update to convo-schema-lint job and stream-parser lib. CI jobs: convo-schema-lint, stream-e2e, sdk-stream-parser.
Sam: impl plan:
- add `tool_call_sequence_id` and `chunk_offset` to streaming events
- add `tool_call_final` event with `final_size` and `checksum`
- keep `tool_call.finished` boolean as legacy until 90 days after rollout
- opt-in header `X-Redwood-Allow-Tool-Reopen: true` for customers who want the new behavior during rollout
Can someone pick up the proto + JSON schema change?
Maria: I'll open a PR for the JSON schema and update the docs page (api/chat#streaming-toolcalls).
Kiara: i'll update stream parsing in sdk-js to honor `sequence_id` + `offset` and prefer `tool_call_final` over `finished`. will also add test for interleaved tool calls.
Alex: Sam — can you handle server-side enforcement (router + runtime) to ensure `tool_call_final` is emitted at most once per sequence_id and that final_size matches aggregated offsets?
Sam: yes, i'll add validation and a small metric `tool_call_reopen_ops` when reopen occurs. also add a debug log with `sequence_id` for tracing.
Ethan: backward-compat note: if customers connect older SDKs they won't see `tool_call_final`. the opt-in header will allow gradual rollout. Also consider a toggle in Console for tenant opt-in.
Maria: docs TODO: include minimal sample streaming event in the API reference and a migration guide showing how to migrate from `finished` -> `tool_call_final` and how to handle missing final_size.
Alex: one more edgecase: if a model never emits `tool_call_final` (bug), we must fallback to `finished` boolean after some timeout. runtime should emit `tool_call_final` with `status: timed_out` and `final_size` based on seen bytes.
Kiara: agree — sdk should expose a promise that resolves on finalization (either `tool_call_final` or legacy `finished` fallback).
Maria: creating PRs now, will link them here. ping us for code review. :eyes:
Sam: leaving a checklist in the PR for e2e test cases: interleaved toolcalls, reopen after finished, checksum mismatch, timeout fallback.
Alex: thanks all. action items summarized: Maria PR (schema + docs), Kiara SDK changes, Sam router/runtime validation + metrics, Alex will update RFC doc and add Console opt-in/flag.
ops-bot: CI queued for convo-schema-lint (expected run: 10m) :gear:
Maria: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/redwood/api-schema/pulls/42 (draft)
Kiara: I'll watch the PR and start a draft in sdk-js repo.
Ethan: small suggestion: add an example of server-side emitted `tool_call_final` with `status: partial` to document partial failures.
Alex: good call — include `status` enum: ok | partial | error | timed_out.
Sam: ok i'll wire up enums and tests. should we announce this on #eng-runtime once schema PR is merged?
Maria: yes — also ping platform docs and support so they can communicate to customers during opt-in.
Alex: thanks, closing thread for now. will update timestamps in RFC once PRs land.
